data.event_date: Targeting the first week of August
data.status: Neo Coffee and Kava is planned as an upscale coffee and kava bar focused on wellness and alcohol-free gathering, combining a full coffee program, kava bar, spirit-free cocktails and a health-oriented food menu. The 2,400-square-foot space will feature an open layout, two bars and lounge seating. Owner Ruth Connors is serving as both contractor and designer.

data.store_name: 242 East Dania Beach Blvd, Dania Beach, FL 33004
data.status: Mystic Social Club is a Caribbean-infused social club and restaurant with indoor-outdoor space, music programming and an attached rental lounge. Manager Philmore McCarthy said the goal is to bring a Caribbean feel to Dania Beach.

data.event_date: Targeting a late July or early August opening
data.status: NY Deli & Juice Bar, led by owner Mohamed Nagi, is preparing a new location in the former SanPeggios Pizza space, targeting a late July or early August opening. The menu centers on New York-style deli offerings with a juice bar section, and the location will include a drive-thru. The company is also opening in Houston, Texas.

data.event_date: Food truck targeting an opening in the next 30 days; restaurant targeting an opening in the next couple of months
data.status: Byte Burgers is preparing a new Tampa location on Westshore Boulevard, operating a food truck in the parking lot before the restaurant opens. The menu includes classic cheeseburgers, truffle burgers, Lebanese-inspired chicken sandwiches and falafel smash burgers. Co-owners Ali and Ahmed Mansour also plan a larger Byte location with a full bar.

data.store_name: 14915 Bruce B Downs Blvd, Tampa, FL 33613
data.event_date: Targeting June 21. The date has not been formally finalized
data.status: Slap Burger is a New York- and New Jersey-born smashburger franchise opening a full-service restaurant near the University of South Florida, seating about 40 guests with late-night service planned. The menu includes single, double and triple smashburgers, Nashville-style chicken sandwiches, shakes and Slap Lemonades.

data.event_date: Targeting an opening window between July 28 and July 31
data.status: Kobu, a new Japanese-focused restaurant from owner Tuna Lui, is preparing to open later this month with seating for about 36 in the dining room and 32 on the patio, plus a reservation-only omakase room priced at about $175 per person. The menu centers on hand rolls, sushi and sashimi, with Japanese wagyu prepared tableside and about 80 percent dry-aged fish.

data.store_name: 1109 Del Prado Blvd S Unit 2, Cape Coral, FL 33990
data.event_date: Targeting an opening in about two to three months, pending permitting
data.status: My Village Play Cafe is an indoor play cafe designed for parents and young children, combining a cafe at the front with an indoor playground in the back. The footprint is more than 3,400 square feet, and the menu includes coffee, espresso drinks, smoothies and children's snacks. Owners are Carolina and Zavier Bravo.

data.store_name: 903 NE 15th Place, Suite 130, Cape Coral, FL 33909
data.event_date: Targeting a public opening about two weeks from the interview, pending final inspections
data.status: Tacos & Tequila Cantina is opening a new Cape Coral location, joining existing restaurants in Naples and Estero. Director of operations Billy Pfaff described the concept as vibrant, with a menu mixing Tex-Mex, American-influenced tacos and traditional Mexican dishes.

data.event_date: Coming soon; will likely open in mid July, current goal July 15th
data.status: Koa Sushi, known for fusing Latin, Japanese and Hawaiian cuisine, is opening its first standalone brick and mortar in Mills 50, taking over the former Grilled Cheezus space. The brand has operated in The Great Southern Box Company Food Hall since 2024 and will offer counter service open as late as 2 a.m. on weekends. Primary owner is Grace Orta.

Chef Kenyatta Ashford is bringing his Afro-Creole concept, Neutral Ground, to a permanent home in Chattanooga after popping up and catering in the area since 2020. The restaurant will seat about 65 guests inside plus a patio of about 30 seats, offering full table service and a bar. The menu blends Creole cuisine and West African culinary traditions.

data.event_date: Targeting late July or early August for opening
data.status: Santa Maria is a full-service Latin tapas restaurant with a Peruvian focus preparing to open in the former Speedi Pig space, owned by chef Mario Garcia. The menu pulls from Peruvian, Colombian, Venezuelan, Mexican and Andean cooking, with a raw bar, smoked-meat component and craft cocktails. It will be the second Santa Maria location, following an original in Cumming.
Speedi Pig, a longtime local barbecue restaurant, closed in 2025 according to Mario Garcia. Santa Maria is taking over the former space and kept the smokers and pitmaster from the BBQ restaurant.

data.event_date: Truck aiming to open in the next 30 days; restaurant aiming to open in the next couple of months
data.status: A new location of Byte Burger is opening in Tampa, with a food truck operating in the parking lot before the restaurant opens. The truck will serve classic cheeseburgers, truffle burgers, Lebanese-inspired chicken sandwiches and falafel smash burgers. Co-owners Ali and Ahmed Mansour plan a larger location with a full bar.

data.event_date: Targeting the second week of October for opening
data.status: Desi Chowrastha Indian Eatery is preparing a new restaurant in the former Curry Mantra Indian Cuisine space, with interior work underway. The menu features chicken, paneer, goat and egg biryani, samosas, dosas, curries and tandoor options. The location will join a recently opened Desi Chowrastha in St. Johns County.

data.store_name: 1040 West Lake Commons Drive Unit 6&7, Martinez, GA 30907
data.status: Griffin's Steakhouse is set to open, opened by co-owners and sisters Diane McCall and Paula Duncan, whose maiden name inspired the name. It is described as an upscale steakhouse open for lunch and dinner, occupying about 3,500 square feet with seating for about 80 guests.

data.event_date: Targeting the second week of October
data.status: Desi Chowrastha Indian Eatery is preparing a new Orlando restaurant in the former Curry Mantra space, undergoing interior work. The menu includes chicken, paneer, goat and egg biryani, samosas, dosas, curries and tandoor items. It will join a recently opened location in St. Johns County.

data.event_date: Targeting mid-July, with July 15 as the current goal
data.status: Koa Sushi is moving from a food hall stall into its first standalone brick-and-mortar restaurant in Mills 50, taking over the former Grilled Cheezus space. The Puerto Rican and Venezuelan-owned brand fuses Japanese, Latin and Hawaiian cooking. Primary owner is Grace Orta.
Nep Sai Gon BBQ & Hotpot is listed as an upcoming Orlando restaurant at the given address. The article text for this entry is cut off before full status and description details are provided.

data.store_name: 242 East Dania Beach Blvd, Dania Beach, FL 33004
data.status: Mystic Social Club is a Caribbean-infused social club and restaurant with indoor-outdoor space, music programming and an attached rental lounge. The menu includes jerk chicken, jerk pork, conch pasta, oxtail pasta and Bahamian conch salad. Manager Philmore McCarthy leads the concept.

data.event_date: Targeting mid-July, with July 16 as the current goal
data.status: A new Keke's Breakfast Cafe location serving the brand's standard breakfast, brunch and lunch format is expected to seat close to 150 guests. Owner Ijmal Ali is also working on additional locations in Pembroke Pines, Tucker and McDonough.
A second South Florida Keke's location is in development from owner Ijmal Ali, expected to seat about 130 to 150 guests.

data.event_date: Planned to open in 2026; targeting an opening later this year
data.status: TrySeafood Grill, from the team behind TrySeafood Grill in Cary, is planned for the former Aviator Smokehouse space, owned by Regina Scott. It is an American-style seafood restaurant offering steamed, fried and grilled seafood, with a full-service dine-in focus and a bar program.

data.event_date: Under construction; estimate opening in mid-August
data.status: A new location of Barrio Burrito Bar is under construction in Riverview, brought by co-franchisees Afiya Fareen and Priyal Patel. The Canadian franchise is known for tacos, burritos, burrito bowls, chips and salsa, fries and churros.

data.event_date: Opening targeted for "a couple months" from lease signing
data.status: Tipsy Taco plans to open in the former Bonjour Main and White Duck Taco space, its first location in downtown Greenville, owned by Frank Roman. The menu centers on casual Tex-Mex with tacos, burritos, fajitas and shareable starters, plus a full bar and planned weekend late-night service.

data.event_date: Expected to open in August, pending final permits and approvals
data.status: Nếp Sài Gòn BBQ & Hotpot, a new Vietnamese grill and hot pot restaurant owned by Oanh Vo, is in development across from Epic Theatres. It offers a family-style dining experience with tabletop grills and hot pots featuring premium meats, fresh seafood, vegetables and rice paper wraps.

data.store_name: 8 Raymond Parks St S, Dawsonville, GA 30534
data.event_date: Targeting the third week of July for opening
data.status: Southern Sassy BBQ plans to launch its food trailer and new commissary kitchen in downtown Dawsonville, serving as owner Tina Everett's base for catering, events and food truck service. The concept focuses on pulled pork and smoked chicken with house-made sauces and dry rub. Everett is preparing for inspections before opening.

data.store_name: 1190 Five Forks Trickum Rd SW, Lawrenceville, GA 30045
data.status: NY Prime Fried Chicken has changed hands and new owner Manvir Singh is preparing to re-open, currently going through licensing and permitting. He intends to update the menu in a few small ways. The restaurant focuses on fried chicken including wings, tenders, sandwiches and drumsticks.

data.location: 13051 Abercorn St, Ste B5, Savannah, GA 31419
data.status: Targeting a mid-July opening
data.short_description: Smashbird is a new fast-casual burger concept from the owners behind several Savannah restaurants, built as mostly grab-and-go with self-service kiosks, QR-code ordering and delivery integration. The menu features thin crispy smashburgers, hand-breaded chicken tenders, wings and shoestring fries. Owners Christine and David Cutlip also operate Savannah Seafood Shack and other local restaurants.

data.location: 2667 Powder Springs Rd SW Ste 102, Marietta, GA 30064
data.status: Targeting an August opening, depending on construction, permitting and inspections
data.short_description: Honey's Po'boys and Gumbo is a Louisiana-inspired restaurant from siblings Angela Randolph and Lionel Thomas, opening a brick-and-mortar after more than 20 years in catering. It will focus mostly on takeout with about 10 to 12 dine-in seats, serving po'boys, gumbo and New Orleans-style snowballs. The restaurant honors the siblings' late mother, nicknamed Honey.

data.location: 3380 Holcomb Bridge Rd, Peachtree Corners, GA 30092
data.status: Moving into the new location in four to six weeks
data.short_description: Fly Chef Restaurant is relocating to a larger Peachtree Corners space expected to seat around 150, up from about 60 at its current Spaulding Drive location, adding event space and expanded catering. The menu, concept and atmosphere will remain the same, featuring Nigerian and Jamaican-style dishes. Owner is Gregory Owie.

data.store_name: Brick City Ice Cream Bar & Grill
data.status: Targeting a July opening
data.short_description: Brick City Ice Cream Bar & Grill is a New Jersey-inspired bar and grill with classic ice cream, alcoholic ice cream beverages and northern comfort foods. The space will include two large bar areas, one combining the main bar with an ice cream counter using a cold-stone-style setup. The menu features Italian hot dogs, Italian cheesesteaks and New Jersey Italian American dishes.

data.status: Targeting mid to late August
data.short_description: Smash Mouth Foods plans to open its fifth location, owned by Jared Hawsey and his father Tracy Hawsey, specializing in customizable smashburgers cooked on a flat top with fresh, hand-cut ingredients. The Prattville restaurant will seat about 21 or 22 guests with a pickup window for online orders. The brand started as a food trailer in Andalusia in 2021 before moving to brick-and-mortar.

data.status: Opening next week
data.short_description: Taqueria El Viajero is a new Mexican taqueria replacing Brandon's Cafe, serving tacos, burritos, burgers and Mexican breakfast options. The restaurant will be open seven days a week. It received a 100/A inspection report on June 15th.

data.location: 118 South Pearl Street, Rocky Mount, NC 27804
data.status: Targeting a June opening
data.short_description: Renaissance Rooftop is a rooftop restaurant, bar and event venue coming to downtown Rocky Mount, owned by Daniel and Tina Bellamy and other investors, built around culture, music, wellness and community. The second-floor and rooftop venue is expected to seat between 60 and 100 guests indoors plus a patio for 25 to 35. The menu, still being finalized, will feature Eastern North Carolina-inspired dishes with cocktails and small plates.

data.status: Preparing to open after final health department approval
data.short_description: Ladder Company Cafe is preparing to open inside Lumberton's historic 1917 fire station, owned by Tommy and Gidget Vickers, in the former garage area restored over two years. The cafe will offer casual dine-in with about 35 seats, focusing on artisan sandwiches and lighter lunch options with no fried food. The couple also operate 219 Elm, another downtown Lumberton project.

data.status: Recently opened
data.short_description: Kabayan Bites has recently opened in Rocky Mount, specializing in Filipino cuisine and serving dine-in and takeout guests seven days a week from 11 am to 9 pm. The menu includes Chicken Inasal, Tapsilog, Pansit Canton noodles and a Kamayan feast. Owner is JM Yravin.

data.location: 2116 New Bern Ave., Suite J, Raleigh, NC 27610
data.status: Targeting an opening in the next two to four weeks
data.short_description: All Kinds is a new local craft shop with beer and wine from owners Carl and Allison Vick, located next to their bakery Little Blue Bakehouse. It will sell local crafts including pottery and artisan goods with a smaller wine-focused beer and wine component. The business will not operate as a restaurant but may offer grab-and-go snacks.

data.status: Targeting an opening in the first week of November
data.short_description: La Victoria Raleigh is targeting an opening in the former Mandolin space, part of Jalmex Hospitality owned by Salvador Alvarez and Juan Sanchez, marking the group's 13th restaurant. The full-service Mexican restaurant will offer about 120 seats, a full bar and party seating in a roughly 4,400-square-foot space with a Tulum-inspired design. The menu focuses on elevated Mexican dining with authentic and Tex-Mex offerings.

data.status: Targeting a late August or early September opening
data.short_description: Burrito Shak is opening a family-owned franchise from Mike and Christine Gracer in the new Kellswater Commons shopping center anchored by Lowe's Foods. The beach-inspired, fast-casual restaurant will serve burritos, burrito bowls, tacos, chips, queso and drinks, seating about 40 guests inside plus outdoor patio seating. This will be the Gracers' first restaurant and first franchise.

data.status: A few weeks away from opening
data.short_description: Sammy's Boba and Coffee, from owner Sam Beng, is a few weeks away from opening in a second-generation former restaurant space, having liquidated a $250,000 stock portfolio to fund the business. In addition to being a cafe, it will serve cooked items including popcorn chicken, wings, Hong Kong-style bubble waffles and Japanese taiyaki. Beng validated demand through pop-ups before investing.

data.status: Preparing to open in the next month; expects to open in a month
data.short_description: Plaza De Espana is a new 100% Spanish restaurant preparing to open in Miami, co-owned by Iris Duran. It will have around 60 seats, serve takeout and dine-in, and have a bar serving beer and wine. Details on the wine list and food menu are pending.

data.location: 242 East Dania Beach Blvd, Dania Beach, FL 33004
data.status: Targeting a fall opening
data.short_description: Mystic Social Club is a new Caribbean-infused social club and restaurant with an attached rental lounge, managed by Philmore McCarthy, currently in the permitting stage. The menu pulls from several Caribbean islands including jerk chicken, jerk pork, conch pasta, oxtail pasta, Trinidadian doubles and Bahamian conch salad, with a full music program. It plans to operate six days a week from lunch through dinner.

data.location: 1109 Del Prado Blvd S Unit 2, Cape Coral, FL 33990
data.status: In development
data.short_description: My Village Play Cafe is a new indoor play cafe concept from couple Carolina and Zavier Bravo, combining a cafe at the front with an indoor playground in the back across more than 3,400 square feet. Cameras cover the play area with a livestream television so parents can supervise while working. The menu will launch compact with coffee, espresso drinks, teas, smoothies, panini and children's snacks.

data.location: 9735 Old St Augustine Rd, Jacksonville, FL 32257
data.status: Renovations about 90 percent complete
data.short_description: Fatboy Friedrice, a Jacksonville-based fried rice concept led by co-owners Joshua Valencia and Jun Marc Quinones, is preparing its first brick-and-mortar restaurant to serve as a home base for its food trucks. The menu builds on fried rice bowls with proteins plus fries, wings, appetizers, boba drinks and lemonades, seating about 60 to 70 guests in a fast-casual format. Renovations are about 90 percent complete with the team focused on staff training.

data.status: Targeted within the next 30 days
data.short_description: Authentic Gyros & Grill, a fast-casual Mediterranean concept led by owner Badr Kbiri Alaoui, is preparing to open a new Tallahassee location, its sixth overall. The menu draws on recipes developed in Cyprus with a focus on gyros, wings with more than 20 flavors, and seafood, and Tallahassee will add breakfast.

data.status: Grand opening June 9; opened June 9
data.short_description: The Authentic Gyros & Grill Fayetteville store held its grand opening June 9 after several soft-opening days with late-night hours. The location is adding breakfast to its menu. It is part of the brand's group of six locations.

data.location: Crestview, FL (serving Okaloosa County and surrounding areas)
data.status: Targeting an early July opening
data.short_description: Polynesian BBQ is a new food truck from Aleki and Lisa Siaki focusing on Polynesian island barbecue drawn from Aleki's Samoan background, targeting an early July opening serving Okaloosa County. The menu includes barbecue boneless chicken, ribs, turkey tail, hot dogs, potato crab salad, and long noodles with corned beef (sapasui). Siaki hopes to secure a permanent parking location.

data.status: Plan to open in July
data.short_description: Mini & Me Play Cafe is a family-centered cafe and play space coming to Pensacola from owner Valeria Barahona, designed with an open layout so parents can relax with coffee while supervising children in the playhouse. The menu includes espresso drinks, croissants, bagels, fruit cups, yogurt and granola. The cafe will host art classes and book readings and plans to offer 100 memberships to local families.
